author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Imprint-year target lookup is duplicated across result components.
findings.consequence: Chronology-link lookup behavior must be kept in sync across download, all, latest, browse, and source-download result renderers; a future change to target construction or missing-target handling can drift between views.
findings.evidence: The owned line builds a local Map from props.imprintYearTargets. The same map-plus-helper pattern is present in LibraryAllResults.vue, LibraryLatestResults.vue, LibraryBrowseResults.vue, and LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue, while all of them consume the same LibraryImprintYearTarget model and expose the same row-year link behavior.
findings.recommendation: Extract the shared lookup policy into a small composable or helper, for example useLibraryImprintYearTargets(imprintYearTargets), returning hasTarget(year) and to(year), and reuse it in the result components while leaving parent target construction unchanged.
verification: Inspected app/components/library/LibraryDownloadResults.vue with physical line numbers, including owned lines 33 and 37-43 plus the template consumers at lines 125-128.
Inspected app/lib/library/component-models.ts for LibraryImprintYearTarget and app/lib/library/page-results.ts for EpubResponse boundaries.
Traced parent construction in app/pages/bibliotek.vue: isImprintYear, imprintYearTo, downloadImprintYearTargets, and the LibraryDownloadResults prop binding.
Compared the analogous imprint-year target handling in LibraryAllResults.vue, LibraryLatestResults.vue, LibraryBrowseResults.vue, and LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue.
Inspected relevant coverage in test/unit/library-component-boundaries.spec.ts, test/e2e/library.behavior.spec.ts, test/ssr/library.spec.ts, and test/helpers/library-imprint-year-cases.ts.
Used read-only inspection commands only; no repository files were modified and no test suite was executed.

Verified the non-null route lookup is guarded by hasImprintYearTarget for the same row year in the template, parent targets are produced only for four-digit imprint years, and existing tests cover download-mode imprint-year navigation.
